records.title: Selective Rollout: Mid-Trajectory Termination for Multi-Sample Agent RL
records.reason: Selective Rollout stops converged multi-sample agent trajectories during GRPO training; its Qwen2.5-7B/ALFWorld run reports 10.7% lower training wall-clock and a directional +2.5 pp held-out shift, but transfer and significance are limited (four seeds, one model/environment). It reduces training-rollout work rather than deployed inference cost.

records.title: When Graph Language Models Go Beyond Memorization
records.reason: Graph-language-model memorization diagnostic protocol, without a serving or inference-efficiency technique.

records.title: OmicsLM: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Multi-Sample Omics Reasoning
records.reason: Omics-domain multimodal LLM application; no inference resource reduction method in the abstract.

records.title: Sparse Tokens Suffice: Jailbreaking Audio Language Models via Token-Aware Gradient Optimization
records.reason: TAGO sparsifies waveform-gradient updates to make audio-model jailbreak optimization cheaper while preserving attack success; this is adversarial attack optimization, not model inference or serving efficiency despite the KV-cache lineage match.

records.title: NoisyCoconut: Counterfactual Consensus via Latent Space Reasoning
records.reason: NoisyCoconut injects latent noise and compares multiple reasoning paths for selective abstention, improving reliability but requiring multiple inference trajectories; no latency, memory or compute-saving result is reported, so its speculative-decoding lineage is weak.
